2026–2027 planner ME3V15026: supervised thesis follows a passed seminar and acceptable proposal. The planner still names the outgoing seminar code; current OER and the replacement seminar entry determine the successor.

curriculum: The Dutch registration has a 120 EC major and 60 EC profiling. The two foundational packages, philosophy course and research seminar account for 75 EC of required coursework. The 7.5 EC thesis, 30 EC depth package and 7.5 EC restricted context choice complete the major. Appendix 2 lists Performing Arts and Creative Technologies and Kunst, cultuur en maatschappij first in their respective lists. Appendix 7 confirms that the depth package is taught and assessed in English within the Dutch track. The four advanced depth courses, research seminar and thesis total 45 EC at level 3, meeting the major minimum. Profiling includes a coherent 30 EC package; external or atypical choices may require approval. No placement is compulsory in the illustrated route.
progression: Finish the two foundation packages in Year 1. Year 2 combines the depth courses in Blocks 1–4 with the context choice in Block 1, philosophy in Block 2 and profiling in Blocks 3 and 4. Year 3 begins with the seminar in Block 1 and thesis in Block 2, or repeats the pair in Blocks 3 and 4. The completed Year 2 depth package satisfies the seminar’s 22.5 EC advanced requirement and three-pass expectation. The thesis uses a passed proposal; the current thesis planner retains the predecessor seminar code MC3V14001, while the 2026–2027 OER and current seminar planner identify its replacement ME3V26011. First-year progression requires 45 of 60 EC under the published BSA.
components: Agenda Setting in Arts and Culture
One of two approved courses. This example uses Arts, Culture and Society.
Develop a research proposal in year three. Entry requires 22.5 EC at advanced level, and students are expected to have passed at least three courses in their depth package.
Carry out the approved research proposal and write the thesis after passing the research seminar.
Includes a coherent 30 EC package, such as a minor, study abroad or a second depth package.
